n: SDVoE compatible scaling receiver for recieving HDMI 2.0, RS-232 (HDMI-TPN-RX107 A-SR)
d: SDVoE compatible scaling receiver for recieving HDMI 2.0, RS-232, audio de-embedder, over 10G copper network cable. Seamless switching, 4K up/down scaling, HDCP, 3D and 4K / UHD (60Hz RGB 4:4:4 , 60Hz YCbCr 4:4:4) compliant with HDR support.
